# Ahmad Fauzan Adiman

> Backend Developer & DevOps Enthusiast based in Indonesia. Final-year Informatics student at Universitas Nurul Jadid (UNUJA). Specializing in scalable backend architectures, cloud infrastructure, and Linux systems.

Ahmad Fauzan Adiman (known online as efzyn / efzynx) is a software engineer focused on reliable backend systems, containerization, cloud engineering, and automated CI/CD pipelines. This site serves as his central engineering gateway, terminal-monochrome portfolio, technical blog, and curated tech news repository.

## Core Technical Skills

- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Express, Fastify, REST APIs, GraphQL, Cloudflare Workers
- **Databases & Storage**: PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, Supabase, Drizzle ORM
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services (AWS Lightsail, EC2, S3), Nginx, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Systemd
- **Operating Systems**: Linux (Arch Linux, Debian, Ubuntu), Shell Scripting / Bash, Performance Tuning
- **Frontend & UI/UX**: Astro (SSR & Static), Tailwind CSS, Terminal Monochrome Design System, Zero-JS Content-First Architecture
